name: Herakleia
summary: The men's feast of Heracles at Cynosarges — sacrifice, games and a table of twelve parasitoi in the gymnasium sacred to the hero outside the walls.
testimonia: Pausanias 1.19.3 (Cynosarges sacred to Heracles; altars of Hebe, Alcmena and Iolaus)
Mikalson (1975) 31–32 (Metageitnion; day within the month approximate)
